name: Mushakan ~Chaya Meibutsu wa Kacchu Musha Musume~
original_name: 武者看 ～茶屋名物は甲冑武者娘～
source:
A long time ago, for searching and subjugation of monsters,
the feudal government established "Task force against monsters."
A samurai girl called Uraha and a ninja called Genmai belong to the task force.
They drop by a teahouse for information gathering and rest.
There is a poster girl called Renge at the teahouse, and she is working alone.
However, through the Genmai's carelessness, the fact that Renge is a dragged-up man is revealed.
His real name is Shouma, and he disguised himself as his older sister Renge.
Renge was very popular with patrons of the teahouse.
Since their parents became sick, she became unable to work because of concentrating on nursing.
If Renge is not there to serve, sales at the teahouse would be reduced drastically,
so he committed himself to disguise her.
Now, the guise came to light, reputation of the shop is damaged,
and Shouma despair of the future of the shop.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ084300.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
很久以前，为了寻找并讨伐魔物，
封建政府成立了“讨妖特遣队”。
名为浦波的武士少女和名为玄米的忍者属于特遣队。
他们顺便去一家茶馆收集信息并休息。
茶馆里有一个叫仁格的海报女郎，她一个人在工作。
然而，由于玄米的疏忽，仁格是一个被拖累的人的事实被揭露了。
他的真名是寿马，他伪装成他的姐姐仁格。
仁格很受茶馆顾客的欢迎。
自从父母生病后，她就因为专心护理而无法工作。
如果没有仁格服务，茶馆的销量就会大幅下降，
所以他决心把她伪装起来。
如今，骗局败露，店铺名誉受损，
和瘦玛对店的未来感到绝望。
